package.description: A command-line utility for BitTorrent torrent file creation, verification, and more.

en-US.description: A command-line utility for BitTorrent torrent file creation, verification, and more.
en-US.longDescription:
Intermodal is a user-friendly and featureful command-line BitTorrent metainfo
utility. The binary is called imdl and runs on Linux, Windows, and macOS.

At the moment, creation, viewing, and verification of .torrent files is
supported.
en-US.name: Intermodal
